title: Dual-Manager Ghost: Sup Org Conflict After Legacy Entity Merger
scenario_text:
**Workday HCM — Worker Profile: Priya Venkatesh (EID: 100847)**
Position: Director, Client Advisory — Wealth Management | Sup Org: WM-Advisory-East | Manager: Robert Cheng (SVP, Advisory Services) | Cost Center: CC-5510 | Location: Charlotte, NC | Effective Date of current position: January 15, 2026

**Workday HCM — Sup Org History for WM-Advisory-East**
Jan 15, 2026: Sup org created (merger of 'PFS-Advisory-East' from Piedmont Financial acquisition)
Jan 15, 2026: Manager assigned: Robert Cheng
Note: Prior sup org 'PFS-Advisory-East' was under legacy Piedmont hierarchy with mgr: Thomas Whitfield

**Adaptive Planning — Q1 2026 Headcount Model**
CC-5510 (Advisory — East): Planned HC = 12 | Filled = 12 | Manager: Thomas Whitfield
CC-5510 note: "Pending re-map to new sup org structure per M&A integration"
Last updated: February 3, 2026

**SharePoint — /org-charts/wealth-management/current.pptx (last modified: December 2025)**
Slide 4: Advisory Services — East Region
Shows: Thomas Whitfield (VP, Piedmont Financial Services) → 11 direct reports including Priya Venkatesh
Footer: "Draft — pending integration restructure"

**ServiceNow HR — Case HRTASK0020114 (March 3, 2026)**
Requester: Priya Venkatesh
Subject: "Incorrect manager showing in performance review system"
Description: "My mid-year review is routing to Thomas Whitfield but he's no longer my manager since the reorg. Robert Cheng should be my reviewer. The old Piedmont hierarchy is still showing in some systems."
Resolution (March 10): "Updated Adaptive Planning mapping. Note: Dynamics 365 compensation module still references legacy cost center owner. Ticket opened with IT for CRM sync."

**Microsoft Teams — #hris-integration (February 12, 2026, 3:22 PM)**
@devon.washington: Heads up — the Piedmont sup org migration is done in Workday as of 1/15 but Adaptive won't pick it up until the next scheduled sync (first week of March). Until then, Tom Whitfield will still show as cost center owner in any planning reports.
@rachel.moss: What about Dynamics? Some comp workflows pull manager from there.
@devon.washington: Dynamics is a separate beast. That's on IT's backlog — probably Q2 at earliest.
@rachel.moss: 😬
@devon.washington: Yeah. Just flag any routing issues to me directly.

**Outlook — Email (March 22, 2026)**
From: thomas.whitfield@cascadefinancial.com
To: devon.washington@cascadefinancial.com
Subject: RE: Year-end rating delegation
> Tom — can you confirm you're no longer the reviewer for the East advisory team?

Devon — I still have 'approve' access in the old PFS performance module that hasn't been decommissioned. I haven't used it since January but technically I could still submit ratings. Should I flag this to compliance?

**Dynamics 365 — Contact Record: Priya Venkatesh**
Reports To: Thomas Whitfield | Department: PFS-Advisory | Last Modified: November 2025
question: It is now June 2026. An auditor asks: in how many systems does Priya Venkatesh currently report to the wrong manager, and what is the compliance risk?

contributor.name: Devon Washington
contributor.title: HRIS & Workforce Planning Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Position management, headcount reconciliation, reorg execution, system-of-record conflicts between HR and Finance

choices: Two systems (Adaptive Planning and Dynamics 365); moderate risk because cost center ownership affects budget approval routing
Three systems (Dynamics 365, Adaptive Planning, and SharePoint org chart); moderate risk requiring cleanup but no immediate compliance exposure
Two systems (Dynamics 365 and the legacy PFS performance module); material compliance risk because an unauthorized individual retains rating approval access
One system (Dynamics 365 only); low risk since CRM reporting lines don't affect compensation or performance decisions
